thread:
harry: Heads-up: Polaris wants a 10-day POC. Theyuilt a rebased Mistral-7B variant and a tiny retrieval bridge (sidecar). They prefer hosted but asked if Dedicated would make sense for steady throughput. Need compatibility check + quick pricing sketch.

julia: Quick clarifying q: is the retrieval bridge a plugin we call over the network or packaged with the model? Also, do they plan to provide tokenizer artifacts?

harry: Polaris said the bridge is an external HTTP service with API key auth. They will include tokenizer.json and metadata. Bundle ETA: Mon morning.

samir: On compatibility: rebased artifact is easiest. We run variant-compat-scan: tokenizer match, layer name patterns, rmsnorm signature. If tokenizer.json present we avoid token-mismatch fallback. For an external retriever we need its endpoint list and auth spec to run a short security review.

elena: Security flags: external plugin -> list allowed DNS/IPs, outbound egress rules, and secrets handling. For rebased weights, require signed manifest and license. For POC, propose 30-day artifact retention and encrypted S3 with KMS; anything longer needs legal signoff.

julia: Performance note: M7B int8 quantized runs ~0.35-0.5x our 13B cost depending on context length. If they expect sustained 150 qps with ~400 token responses, recommend Dedicated trial or host with soft caps. I'll draft two price options.

qa-bot: preflight: upload -> variant-scan -> quant-sim -> retriever-eval -> privacy-check. status: awaiting upload.

harry: Action items: 1) I'll request full bundle + retriever README + signed manifest. 2) Samir to estimate infra for 150 qps/400 tokens by EOD. 3) Elena to list security checklist items for the customer. 4) Julia to prepare two price options (hosted vs 2-week dedicated).

samir: For infra estimate: rough calc: 150 qps * 400 tokens = 60k tokens/sec ~3.6M tokens/min. With batching/prefix cache you can get ~2x efficiency; still expect multiple A100-equivalents for sustained low-latency. Will provide a numeric back-of-envelope.

elena: I'll prepare a short note we can send: accepted artifact types, retention window, required attestations for training data, and retriever network requirements.

julia: I'll include an explicit sentence about on-prem option adding ~10 business days to onboarding and KMS provisioning.

harry: Thanks team 680. I'll send the customer checklist and timeline once I get the bundle.

[thread end]
